exposure: Women with fever onset at latent phase vs. active labor
Onset of fever during labor (latent vs. active)
outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean delivery)
cohort: 1436 women at term carrying a singleton gestation with suspected chorioamnionitis undergoing a trial of labor between 2011 and 2019 at a tertiary medical center.
finding: Women with chorioamnionitis had a high rate of cesarean delivery, with nulliparity and onset of fever prior to active labor being the strongest independent predictors.
